<!-- pr-reviewer: a637e91b287935db2314349fdfe19d1146280786 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The Heights tab uses the existing advice function after the draft editors run. The new tests cover draft edits, prior operations, units, stock changes, and unchanged frames. This change affects display only. It does not change posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or collision checks. No goldens changed.

Local results, trial-merged with upstream main `b629dc7e8805fa437e90c1a56dae7063f0d9dbfa`:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --no-run -j 6`: passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -j 6 -- --test-threads=1`, from `crates/ui`: 1106 passed, 7 ignored.
- All three new clearance advice tests passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -j 6 -- -D warnings`: passed.
- No runner or pixel snapshot tests ran. No mutations ran because this change affects display only.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/height_memo.rs:109`: Include the effective machine kind in the advice cache key. The advice function checks `machine::kind_of_setup` for drilling. A setup without its own machine follows the document machine. `LoadMachine` changes that singleton without changing the current key. After a drill caches advice on a mill, a document machine change to a lathe retains the advice. The reverse change can retain a missing warning. Read the effective kind into the key. Add a test that changes the document machine between these kinds and checks both transitions.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/params_page.rs:263` and the PR body: Add before and after screenshots of the Heights tab. The body currently has no screenshots. Show the clearance advice for the same operation and stock. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the body. Do not commit images to the PR branch.

Test limitations:

The default parallel UI suite failed twice: 1105 passed, 1 failed, 7 ignored. Both runs failed in `egui_app::tests::setup_mount_pages::each_setup_picks_its_own_machine_and_post_and_posts_one_file_per_mount`, at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs:1504`:

```text
Harness::run exceeded max_steps (4)
```

That test passed alone. The full serial suite passed. The parallel upstream baseline also failed, but in a different test: `diag::tests::diag_lines_are_tracing_events_at_their_level`, at `crates/ui/src/diag.rs:139`. The setup test passed on that baseline. The exact setup timeout is therefore not confirmed as an existing upstream failure. The parallel suite is not green.

The PR remains a draft while these findings are open.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. The advice cache key now includes the effective machine kind.
   Pins: `drill_advice_follows_document_machine_from_mill_to_lathe_and_back` and `drill_advice_follows_document_machine_from_lathe_to_mill_and_back`.
   Both pins fail when the machine-kind key is removed. Both pass when the fix is restored.
   The pins also check cache reuse on unchanged frames.
2. The PR body now links before and after Heights screenshots for the same contour, stock, and heights.
   [Before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/78abec3194a70fbba1067b66923c23df3d671bb2/2498/heights-before.png) and [after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/78abec3194a70fbba1067b66923c23df3d671bb2/2498/heights-after.png) capture runs passed.
   The images use the production page and headless GPU renderer. They are stored only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch.
   No images or review evidence were added to the PR branch.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed all nine steps.
The parallel UI suite passed: 1104 passed, 7 ignored.
`cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -j 6 -- -D warnings` passed.

New head: `30a4ba58c7f04cb7a8a646bd22dcc3701ecb93bb`.
Please re-review this head. The PR remains a draft.
